partition.pool_capacity: P0 budget >= sum all row capacities

rules: One current matching row exactly equals allocation projection in row field order-agnostic dict equality; at least one partition row.
Each row allocation_id nonempty unique string; capacity P0 budget; CPU IDs nonempty unique exact nonnegative integers; devices unique nonempty text list (empty allowed).
No CPU or GPU identifiers shared across rows.
Sum each dimension capacities across rows <= pool_capacity dimension.
Active whole capture interval and matching pool_id/host/boot_id/lease_root; current allocation fields exact.
Optional second disjoint row may use spare CPU ID not in raw discovery affinity, provided pool_capacity accounts for it.
Partition reference retained in expanded capture custody closure and final rechecked.
